name: PT Paninvest Tbk
summary: PT Paninvest Tbk provides banking and multi financing products and services in Indonesia. It operates through Life Insurance and Business Consulting Service; Banking and Multi-Finance; Trade and Services; and Tourist segments. The company offers Sharia banking products and services; financing and mutual funds services; and death, whole life, annuity, endowment, endowment combine, universal life, unit-linked, personal accident, and health insurance products. It also provides business consulting, management, and general administration services; trading and services; and management consulting services in the field of archives.
